name: The Blind Griffin
source: It's the roaring 20's. Alcohol-loving Americans are chafing underneath the restrictions of Prohibition, but speakeasies have thankfully risen to fill the void with ill-begotten booze. The Blind Griffin is one such speakeasy in San Francisco, California, but it's about to go out of business...because its employees are a den of magicians who are more concerned with their magical studies and experiments than moonshine! Desperate not to lose the building that has become their haven, they hire the first streetsmart guttersnipe they find with some experience to help turn things around, but could she perhaps turn out to be the strongest magician of them all?
translation: 这是咆哮的20年代。嗜酒的美国人在禁酒令的限制下感到恼火，但值得庆幸的是，地下酒吧已经崛起，用不正当的酒来填补这一空白。盲人狮鹫就是加利福尼亚州旧金山的一家地下酒吧，但它即将倒闭……因为它的员工都是魔术师的巢穴，他们更关心他们的魔法研究和实验，而不是私酒！由于不顾一切地不想失去这座已成为他们避难所的建筑，他们雇佣了他们找到的第一个具有一定经验的街头聪明人来帮助扭转局面，但她也许会成为他们中最强大的魔术师呢？
